lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is wider in the anterior-midsection (approx. 40-50 pixels) and constricts significantly in the posterior region (approx. 20-25 pixels).
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed at the dorsal terminus of the 11th line (counting anterior to posterior), where the line splits into two distinct segments near the spinal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1 and 2 (anterior) terminate mid-torso; lines 11 and 12 (posterior) are segmented into abbreviated dashes and elliptical blobs before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, centered vertically between the knee joint and the base of the tail.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally with the ventral terminus of the 10th vertical line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Two white circular spots on the lower mandible/cheek; a partial white chevron on the bridge of the nose; a distinct white transverse band on the mid-lower forelimb.
